dogecoin.text: @Bitcoin This is first time since crash with $BTC by far outperforming other #cryptos, including $ETH or $DOGE - in my view a healthy sign!

Despite the popular view that every memecoin except $DOGE will hit 0 after one or two cycles, I think any coin that cracks its previous ATH in the next few weeks could stick around much longer.

I’d be shocked if these five don’t: $PEPE, $BONK, $WIF, $MOG, and… $REKT.
